beats.say: N equals ten log of I over K. The dishwasher is sixty-two decibels, and the pump is fifty.
We want how many times as intense: a ratio. Plan: put in both readings, subtract, then un-log.
Put in the dishwasher: sixty-two equals ten log of I D over K.
And the pump: fifty equals ten log of I P over K.
Subtract the two readings. Sixty-two minus fifty equals the difference of the two logs.
Both logs have the same base, ten. Minus Power joins them into one log of a division.
So twelve equals ten log of I D over K, divided by I P over K.
The K cancels. Twelve equals ten log of I D over I P.
Divide both sides by ten. Log of the ratio is one point two.
Log is base ten, so un-log with ten to the power. The ratio is ten to the power one point two.
So the dishwasher is fifteen point eight times as intense, correct to three significant figures.
asks: How do I key 10 to the 1.2?

beats.say: Watch out: the answer is not twelve. Twelve is the difference in decibels, not how many times.
